definitions.gloss: advertising fee; advertising charge; ad revenue
definitions.explanation: The money paid for placing an advertisement, or the revenue earned from carrying advertisements.

examples.japanese: {広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧CM⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To pay an advertising fee to run a commercial.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成|な}り{立|た}っている→成り立つ：07921_naritatsu⟧。
examples.english: This magazine is sustained by advertising revenue.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クリック→クリック：05275_kurikku⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Online advertising fees change depending on the number of clicks.

notes:
⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ (advertisement) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee, charge). Can refer both to the cost of placing an ad and to the revenue earned from hosting ads. Common in media, marketing, and business discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ — pay advertising fees
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧ — advertising revenue
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — advertising fees are high
- {広告料|こうこくりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}する→運営する：21987_uneisuru⟧ — operate on advertising revenue

- ⟦{広告費|こうこくひ}→広告費：30159_koukokuhi⟧ — advertising expenses — focuses on the cost side from the advertiser's perspective
- {掲載料|けいさいりょう} — publication fee; listing fee — the fee for having something published or listed
